description: Engine and whichpart-api code in one change set (proof of concept, no real customers): the admin console review after ADR 0023. Engine: a gas or fire stop now records its escalation in the turn audit, as the normal path does (the transcript summary reads the audit). whichpart-api: the unused /admin/transcripts/stats and /policy routes removed; the never-set lastTraceId dropped from transcript records; the dead embedding-index summary (knowledge-inspect/index-meta.json) no longer shipped or reported, so Diagnostics can no longer show a false 'degraded' knowledge state; the diagnostics 'routing' and 'links' leftovers removed; the Settings link to Error Codes points at #error-codes; the help-hub family id for washing machines matches the stored family (washing-machine); the unused S3 helpers and exports removed. No environment change.
